items.title: Age rating is unset for Oenora, SharedSpaceLab, and SentiPods
items.body: All 6 real macOS records have primary category and copyright. Age rating set for Mallinbook, Pfoliolio, Screenker; still UNSET for Oenora, SharedSpaceLab, SentiPods pending owner judgment (wine subject matter, peer-to-peer chat, and unfiltered third-party content respectively). SentiPods desktop screenshots uploaded 2026-08-13 (3 at 2880x1800, assetDeliveryState COMPLETE). Mallinbook now has valid build 18 on both platforms; the earlier no-build statement was stale.
items.action: Set the ASC age rating for Oenora, SharedSpaceLab, and SentiPods. Each needs an owner judgement call on its subject matter.

items.title: PeerLink source is missing, so PickledBalls cannot be built here
items.body: PickledBalls project.yml now links a local PeerLink package at ../peerlink for local-network live game transport. The sibling ~/peerlink directory is missing on this machine, and obvious GitHub repo names billdonner/peerlink, billdonner/pickledpeerlink, and billdonner/picklepeerlink were not found. Local PickledBalls builds cannot be regenerated or verified here until PeerLink is restored or its source repo is identified.
items.action: Locate or recreate the PeerLink package and restore it at ~/peerlink, or repoint PickledBalls project.yml at a resolvable source.

items.title: Mallinbook's ASC privacy URL 404s and SentiPods has none
items.body: Pfoliolio's billdonner.com marketing/support route and the legacy Oliopfolio redirect are now live. Mallinbook's ASC privacy URL remains 404 and SentiPods still has no ASC privacyPolicyUrl.
items.action: Publish a working privacy URL for Mallinbook and add a privacyPolicyUrl to the SentiPods ASC record.

items.title: Nagzerver production cannot be reproduced from Git main
items.body: OPEN. Fly release v100 of bd-nagzerver contains the active PickledBalls and legacy PickleFamilia implementations, but those files are absent from every Git main ref inspected. The exact non-secret deployed source is preserved on private branch recovery/deployed-2026-06-30 at a57211b and generates all 163 live API paths. Review it before merging: 1,113 of 1,114 tests pass, while tests/test_pickleball_sessions.py::test_player_schedule exposes a confirmed-occurrence schedule defect. Until reconciled, Git main cannot reproduce production.
items.action: Review private branch recovery/deployed-2026-06-30 at a57211b, fix the test_player_schedule defect, and merge it so main reproduces production.

items.title: Three recorded repo paths do not resolve on this machine
items.body: Recorded repo paths ~/123words, ~/bookmaker, and ~/mallinbook did not resolve as local directories on this machine during the reboot-readiness audit; retained entity facts are preserved from prior observed scans.
items.action: Clone or relocate the three repos on this machine, or record them as github:-only so the paths stop reading as missing.

items.title: Neither website enforces the free vs commercial product-line split
items.body: Owner established two product lines: BillDonner.com apps are permanently free, while 1041soft.com is commercial-grade. workin On and the two MasterIndex Explorer binaries are confirmed BillDonner.com products. The current presentations do not yet enforce the split: billdonner.com/apps lists every active app and 1041soft.com still serves /workinon/. Keep this gap open until all apps are classified and both publication pipelines filter by productLine.
items.action: Classify every app by productLine, then filter both publication pipelines so billdonner.com and 1041soft.com stop cross-listing.

items.title: Oenora has an unused ASC macOS version with no builds
items.body: SharedSpaceLab remains aligned through Mac Catalyst. Oenora deliberately reverted Catalyst and added a native Developer ID target with bundle com.billdonner.oenora.mac; its existing ASC MAC_OS 1.0 record belongs to com.billdonner.oenora and has no builds. Preserve the intentional direct-distribution target, but decide whether to remove the unused ASC macOS version or add a separate App Store-compatible target.
items.action: Decide: remove the unused ASC macOS version, or add an App Store-compatible Mac target alongside the Developer ID one.

items.title: Universal links have never worked; AASA was never served
items.body: nagz/docs/.well-known/apple-app-site-association existed but was never served - Jekyll ignores dot-directories by default, so the URL returned 404 for as long as the site was up. Universal links from that domain have therefore never functioned; this is not a regression from the 1041soft.com migration. Making them work needs a .nojekyll file, the AASA served with the correct content type, and the app's associated-domains entitlement pointed at 1041soft.com.
items.action: If universal links are still wanted: add .nojekyll, serve the AASA with the right content type, and point the entitlement at 1041soft.com.

items.title: 14 active tasks have no recorded run history
items.body: Nothing records when these tasks last ran, so none of them can be evaluated for being overdue. Until runs are recorded, task cadence produces no signal at all.
items.action: Record a completion timestamp per taskId under taskRuns in current/attention-state.json when a task runs; overdue cards then appear on their own.
items.evidence: tasks/index.json active tasks absent from current/attention-state.json taskRuns

items.title: SentiPods README states a Mac bundle id that project.yml contradicts
items.body: sentipods README.md states the Mac bundle is com.sentipods.mac, but project.yml sets the SentipodsMac target to com.sentipods.app - one universal-purchase record, not two apps. README is stale.
items.action: Update sentipods README.md to state com.sentipods.app, matching project.yml.

items.title: Household-communications lineage has open naming and migration decisions
items.body: Nagz, Famster, and SharedSpaceLab are one household-communications lineage rather than three independent products. SharedSpaceLab is the active successor prototype, Nagz the working legacy reference, and Famster a concept-only shell. ConversationLab and CoordinationLab are reusable kernel candidates. Product naming, product-line assignment, and any future server migration remain open decisions.
items.action: Decide product naming, product-line assignment, and whether SharedSpaceLab migrates off Nagzerver.
